claims: The 130th Boston Marathon is held on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon is held on Patriots' Day.
The 130th Boston Marathon route runs from Hopkinton to Copley Square.
The 130th Boston Marathon features six start waves.
The 2026 Boston Marathon is organized by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.).
The qualifying window for the 2026 Boston Marathon ran from September 1, 2024, to September 12, 2025.

24,362 qualifiers were accepted out of 33,249 applicants for the 2026 Boston Marathon.

Women’s wheelchair starts at 9:05 a.m. local time in the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Men’s elite starts at 9:37 a.m. local time in the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Women’s elite starts at 9:45 a.m. local time in the 2026 Boston Marathon.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course is 26.2 miles long.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course runs through 8 cities and towns.
The 2026 Boston Marathon course culminates in downtown Boston.
The 2026 Boston Marathon includes 2025 champions John Korir and Sharon Lokedi.
The 2026 Boston Marathon includes Sara Hall and Jenny Simpson.
The 2026 Boston Marathon has approximately 30,000 participants from over 130 countries.
